meta.name: Half CA
meta.description:
Two CA Aspirants from two different ends of the spectrum of the course, Archie and Niraj embark on the journey of one of the toughest courses and face the obstacles it has to offer.

Rated U/A 16+ · Returning Series · First aired 26 Jul 2023 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: The Viral Fever · Network: Amazon miniTV, Amazon MX Player

Complete series. On your server: S1 5/5 | S2 5/5

On your server — Audio: Hindi (from file names)

videos.title: CA Kyu Karna Hai?
videos.overview: Archie chose to pursue CA after the 12th but realizes its difficulty only upon starting. Meanwhile, Niraj fails his CA Final exams once again. He now faces a decision: to persist in CA or abandon it and join his family business.

videos.title: Overhead Expenses
videos.overview: Having reached Mumbai for her IPCC studies, Archie struggles in adjusting to the big city as well as finding a good IPCC coaching. Meanwhile, Niraj tries coping with his societal status of being just a Half CA in his new firm in Mumbai.

videos.title: Write Off
videos.overview: Archie gets distracted from her CA Inter studies when there is a fest in her B. Com College where she wants to volunteer. Meanwhile, Niraj quits the firm to fully focus on his 3rd and probably last attempt at CA final exams.

videos.title: Group 1 Group 2
videos.overview: On realising that she might not be taking her CA Inter preparation as seriously as she should, Archie goes all in as she chooses to give both groups in the CA Inter exams. Meanwhile, Niraj gives his 3rd CA Final attempt which seemingly goes well.

videos.title: Balance Sheet
videos.overview: Archie sits for her CA Inter exams and has a breakdown when her first paper doesn’t go well. Meanwhile, Niraj tries adjusting to his new life back home.

videos.title: New Account
videos.overview: Archie passes her 1st group of CA inter only to decide which firm she will pursue her articleship in while Niraj faces an insecurity in his new coaching after giving CA another chance.

videos.title: Orientation
videos.overview: Archie struggles as her new firm isn't quite how she expected it to be and misses out on her time with the gang. Niraj bumps into someone special from his past and finds trouble dealing with the situation.

videos.title: Reconciliation
videos.overview: Archie lies at her firm about Tejas pursuing CA as well and must deal with the truth when Tejas finds out. Niraj and Kavya face the horrors of their past only to realise their mistakes.

videos.title: Articleship Vs Exams
videos.overview: Archie struggles to balance her articleship and studies as her CA inter exams are around the corner while Niraj and Kavya rekindle their relationship in Mumbai.

videos.title: Balancing Figures
videos.overview: Archie cleans up the mess at her firm days before her CA inter exam while Niraj gives his CA journey a final attempt.
